hints.title: Prefix Sum Transformation
hints.text: Compute prefix sums so subarray sums can be evaluated in constant time.

hints.title: Formulate Inequalities
hints.text: For a left split index i, find bounds on middle split j such that pref[i] <= pref[j] - pref[i] <= total - pref[j].

hints.title: Binary Search for Valid Bounds
hints.text: Use binary search to find min j satisfying 2 * pref[i] <= pref[j] and max j satisfying 2 * pref[j] <= total + pref[i].

hints.title: Full Implementation
hints.text:
```python
import bisect

class Solution:
    def waysToSplit(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        MOD = 10**9 + 7
        n = len(nums)
        pref = [0] * (n + 1)
        for i in range(n):
            pref[i + 1] = pref[i] + nums[i]
        total = pref[n]
        ans = 0

        for i in range(1, n - 1):
            left_sum = pref[i]
            if left_sum * 3 > total:
                break
            min_j = bisect.bisect_left(pref, 2 * left_sum, i + 1, n)
            max_j = bisect.bisect_right(pref, (total + left_sum) // 2, i + 1, n) - 1
            if min_j <= max_j:
                ans = (ans + (max_j - min_j + 1)) % MOD
        return ans
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating both split points naively takes O(n^2) time, which times out for n = 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Binary search on monotonic prefix sums finds valid middle boundaries in O(log n) per left boundary.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate derives prefix sum inequalities and uses binary search or two pointers to count splits.
